planets.name: KELT-10 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of KELT-10 with a 4.17-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: KELT-10 b was found in 2016 by KELT-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around KELT-10. Its orbit and size follow Kuhn et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
